records.issue_text: Timezone unit mismatch: workingHour.startTime/endTime are in organizer's timezone but compared against slot times derived from time.utc(), so comparisons are off by the organizer's UTC offset
records.rationale: In `checkIfIsAvailable`, slot times are converted to UTC (`const slotStartTime = time.utc(); const slotEndTime = time.add(...).utc();`) and then compared against `workingHours` using `slotStartTime.hour()/minute()` (UTC clock) without applying `organizerTimeZone` or `schedule.timeZone`. If `workingHours.startTime/endTime` are defined as minutes-from-midnight in the organizer’s local timezone (as is typical), this UTC-based comparison will be shifted by the organizer’s UTC offset, causing incorrect availability filtering.
records.stripped_text: Timezone unit mismatch: workingHour.startTime/endTime are in organizer's timezone but compared against slot times derived from time.utc(), so comparisons are off by the organizer's UTC offset

records.issue_text: Composite failure: broken `end` variable in override boundary checks plus the dateOverrideExist return-true path makes slots on override dates incorrectly available, causing booked-time collisions
records.rationale: In `checkIfIsAvailable`, once a date override exists for the slot’s day, the code returns `true` immediately (`if (dateOverrideExist) { return true; }`), which bypasses the later `busy.every(...)` checks entirely—so slots can be marked available even if they overlap existing busy/booked times. Additionally, the working-hours bounds check computes `end` incorrectly as the same value as `start` (`const end = slotStartTime.hour() * 60 + slotStartTime.minute();`), so the “outside working hours” logic is broken and will not correctly enforce end-time bounds.
records.stripped_text: Composite failure: broken `end` variable in override boundary checks plus the dateOverrideExist return-true path makes slots on override dates incorrectly available, causing booked-time collisions
